description: A mod that optimizes hoppers and their interactions with entities and inventories. It drastically reduces hopper lag without changing any behavior.

mods.name: Hopper Optimizations
mods.description: Optimization Mod for hoppers and everything that interacts with it.

releases.notes:
### Downloads
[HopperOptimizations](https://github.com/2No2Name/hopperOptimizations/releases/download/0.3.6/hopperOptimizations-1.16.5-0.3.6.jar)
[Lithium fork dependency](https://github.com/2No2Name/lithium-fabric/releases/download/v0.6.4/hopperoptimizations-lithium-mc1.16.5-0.6.4.jar) (required for hopper optimizations, this also includes the complete lithium optimization mod)
### Overview
Hopper Optimizations is a fabric mod that reduces hopper, hopper minecart and comparator lag a lot without breaking any contraptions or odd vanilla behaviors. If you notice any difference to vanilla (besides the better performance), please open an issue, so I can fix that.

### Changes
- fix: hoppers sometimes accessing unloaded blockentities
Read the README (at https://github.com/2No2Name/hopperOptimizations) for more information.

### Support the author
You can support me on [patreon](https://www.patreon.com/2No2Name).

releases.notes:
Fixed player transferring items causing incorrect datastructure entries when using playerHopperOptimizations.
Fixed hoppers not interacting with entities that were teleported towards them when using optimizedEntityHopperInteraction.

Added inventoryCheckOnBlockUpdate rule - cache non-existence of inventory blocks until the next block update.
Added optimizations for hoppers interacting with lots of entities.
Added removal of unused cached data to use less memory.
Replaced playerHopperOptimizations rule with inverted playerInventoryDeoptimization rule.
Added a debug rule. Only use for debugging.

Available for 1.15.1 and 1.14.4 (you can request other versions)
Requires fabric carpet. Version that doesn't require fabric carpet coming soon.

Use at your own risk (take a backup before loading your world).
